# `git_diff`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] git_diff`

Show changes between commits, commit and working tree, etc. Runs 'git diff' in the working directory.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no | Limit diff to a specific file or directory |
| `staged` | boolean | no | Show staged changes (--staged / --cached) |
